mutations.because: dropping templates from RESERVED_ROUTE_SEGMENTS lets a campaign slugged templates collide with the templates/ route (a saved creative template's own directory) and, on fs, cost that campaign its GET /campaigns/:id entirely (D179). The route-tree test derives the static segment list from the real route directory and fails listing any segment the caller's array omits.
command: every static segment on disk is in RESERVED_ROUTE_SEGMENTS
